heatrises.def: A Warlock buff from consuming your grenade with the Heat Rises aspect: long glides and extra airborne effectiveness, and airborne kills extend it.
heatrises.q: Hold to consume your grenade, gaining Heat Rises

solarweapon.def: Damage or final blows from Solar weapons; some Solar fragments trigger on them.
solarweapon.q: Solar weapon final blows grant you and your allies increased health for a short duration.

solarability.def: Damage or final blows from Solar grenades, melees, class abilities or Supers.
solarability.q: Solar ability final blows, Hammer of Sol impacts, and defeating scorched targets creates Sunspots.

weapon.def: Damage or final blows from any weapon. Some Supers make the caster's weapon damage count as Super damage.
weapon.q: Weapon Damage dealt by the Caster is counted as Super Ability Damage.

hellion.def: A Solar mortar summoned by your class ability (Warlock aspect) that lobs scorching projectiles at distant targets; it counts as a grenade.
hellion.q: Hellion projectiles count as a Grenade Ability and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects.

improvisedexplosive.def: A Solar explosive charged by kills (Hunter aspect Gunpowder Gamble) that replaces your grenade and ignites when shot or after a delay; it counts as both a grenade and an ignition.
improvisedexplosive.q: Gunpowder Gamble counts both as an Ignition and a Grenade Ability.

scorchingrounds.def: A weapon buff that makes your Solar and Kinetic weapon hits scorch targets.
scorchingrounds.q: Scoring a Non-DoT Kinetic or Solar Direct/Explosive Weapon Hit inflicts Scorch
